about: IN-7 materiality goldens on ci/fixtures/in-company (company 901, CY 2025, KPI tracking on for the case only). Worked by hand. Topic of a KPI = the esrs_topic of the ESRS disclosures it maps to (data/kpi/mappings.json): GHG_SCOPE1, GHG_SCOPE2_LB → E1; WATER_WITHDRAWAL → E3; EMPLOYEES_TOTAL, LTIFR, FATALITIES → S1.

cases.name: worst-status roll-up, weights, scored false (S1 has no financial score)
cases.working: E1: Scope 1 company figure 900+460+230 = 1,590 → (2,500−1,590)/1,500 = 60.7 % of the way vs ~40 % expected (end 2023 → end 2030 at today) → on_track; Scope 2 780 vs 800 → 400 is 5 % vs ~94 % expected → off_track; worst = off_track, on 1, off 1. E3: 2025 85 ≤ the 2025 target 90 → reached (on 1; KPI-9 reads figures from the baseline year to the target year only). S1: no targets → no_data. Weights: the period has approved tCO₂e → E1 = 10; E3 1 of 6 KPIs → 1 + 9 × 16.67 % = 2.5; S1 3 of 6 → 5.5. E5 isn't material: no point.
